question: Is a label-fitted binary event partition stable across independent whole-chain fitting groups, distinct from the current proxy, and rich in intervening input changes? This is neither physical quote truth nor forecasting utility.
prior_result: Previous signed-pair unique-key gate44/237 failed and stays failed. This is a new preregistered estimand: row/event-weighted binary update decisions; no retroactive rescue.

inputs.historical_role: Descriptive comparator only; instance fit provenance unresolved.

sampling.unit: whole chain, all its train row groups read; reset online state at every20k sequence boundary as scorer does
sampling.eligible: Exclude every chain with ANY valid member, every prior deep-architecture fit/audit chain, any chain containing corrupt row-group528, and chains whose train class labels are not uniformly one of0..3. No validation parquet is read.
sampling.audit: 8 class0,8 class1,8 class2,64 class3 chains ordered SHA256(CLOCK2-audit:<chain>); all sequences per chain.
sampling.fit: After removing audit chains, order class3 chains by SHA256(CLOCK2-fit:<chain>); first256 chains split alternating ranks into A and B (128 each), all sequences per chain.
sampling.exposure: Previously exposed data; excluding prior samples does not restore fresh generalization confirmation. Metadata classes stratify audit only; never route inference.

decoder.fit: For every exact raw full22 code-change row, round previous/current float32 vectors to4 decimals; quantize training target pair by0.65687 with np.rint; count q_t-q_(t-1). Modal jump first-observed tie order, converted to(-jump0,jump1). Store row support, unique-chain support, modal purity, tie count and competing outcomes. No audit labels/masks loaded.
decoder.candidate: On a code event use Boolean(dask!=0 OR dbid!=0) if key known, otherwise original EV_I0PX=(x0_changed AND x11_changed). All non-code rows and row0 False. Same rule all classes; no label-derived class route.
decoder.physical_limit: Mode stability establishes reproducibility of a learned partition, not correct market quotes. No spread-path anchoring used; direct mapping is fixed estimand.
decoder.rounding: Count exact raw changes collapsing to same rounded code; map rounded code to distinct raw float32 bit signatures and count aliases; count transition keys with competing raw binary proxy flags.

primary_estimands: For class3 separately and for each other class: freshA/B candidate-mask XOR / all rows excluding reset; XOR / exact code events; XOR / union candidate updates. Report numerators and denominators.
On transitions known to both fitted tables: binary zero/nonzero disagreement and signed-pair disagreement, event-weighted; report unweighted unique-key statistics separately, never interchange them.
FreshA versus historical and freshB versus historical, same binary metrics but marked descriptive. Unknown fallback and only-one-known slices explicitly reported.
Per-chain candidate event-rate, proxy-drop fraction, missed-proxy update fraction, known coverage, gap p50/p90/p99/max and closed/censored interval counts.

fixed_pair_strata: both known with each row support>=20, each chain support>=3 and each modal purity>=.95
both known, any row support<20 or any chain support<3
both known, row/chain support criteria met but any purity<.95
support_slices.report: Per-stratum chain-aggregated event denominators and binary/signed disagreement; conditional chain-bootstrap ratios. Thresholds inherited/declared descriptors, not probability-of-correct-quote labels.

uncertainty.joint_bootstrap: Exactly1000 draws seed20261001. Each draw independently resamples128 fit-A chains,128 fit-B chains and audit chains with replacement within market class. Recompute modal zero/nonzero lookup from bootstrapped per-chain outcome counts (missing boot keys fallback); aggregate binary disagreements from audit per-key/per-proxy sufficient statistics weighted by audit chain multiplicities. Report percentile2.5/97.5 intervals. Tie breaking preserves original first-observed outcome order.
uncertainty.conditional_bootstrap: Reuse the SAME1000 audit multiplicity draws with original fixed maps to report conditional audit-chain intervals and support strata; distinguish them from joint fit+audit intervals. These are paired descriptive intervals, not row-IID tests or selection-corrected claims.
uncertainty.fit_stability: For audit-used fitted keys report bootstrap probability of nonzero modal move and probability key absent. Summarize audit-event-weighted binary flips vs original map, by fixed support/purity strata.
uncertainty.limits: Only two disjoint fit groups, one partition design and previously exposed data; joint bootstrap is conditional on sampled chains/recipe. It cannot certify causal quote semantics or unseen transfer.

interval_EDA.clock: freshA fixed direct/fallback mask only; choice fixed before outcomes
interval_EDA.closed_interval: Between consecutive candidate events s<t within one sequence. Gap=t-s. Count strictly interior rows s+1..t-1 with any i0 volume-code change(x22:44), any i0 trade-code change(x44:52), and any i1 feature-code change(x52:104). These are encoded input-update counts, NOT executed trades or physical order flow.
report: per-chain interval/gap distribution, fraction of closed intervals with >=1 and >=4 interior updates for each block
for gap bins1,2-4,5-16,17-64,65+: interval counts, interior update sums and nonempty fractions
right-censored tail length and prefix before first event; no complete-interval interpretation of censored pieces
conditional chain-bootstrap CIs for interval-weighted nonempty fractions and mean interior update count; also equal-chain descriptive quantiles to avoid only long-chain dominance
interval_EDA.interpretation: A nonempty history makes h_t versus z_t a concrete representation contrast, not evidence that the instantaneous features fail to summarize it or that the history forecasts targets.

checks: All fitA/fitB/audit chain sets disjoint, none contains any validation member; verify exact metadata hashes and all train row-group/class membership.
Fingerprint train parquet before/after and incremental SHA256 of every used feature array, plus target arrays for fit only; source/plan/code hashes recorded.
Binary batch/streaming/chunk mask equality and fixed prefix cuts1,99,500,5000,19999 on first audit sequence of each class for both fresh maps; no audit labels passed.
Bootstrap sufficient-statistic metric at unit weights equals direct full-scan numerator/denominator exactly; zero denominators become null, never0.
Historical table never becomes fit input; report all listed outcomes and timeout/error without a replacement recipe.

decision.not_a_promotion_gate: No GPU/forecasting allocation follows automatically; report descriptive uncertainty and failures.
decision.statistical_materiality: A reproducible useful-partition premise requires class3 A/B joint95% upper bound on binary XOR/code_events<=1%, while both fresh maps drop>=1% proxy events on at least90% of class3 audit chains. This is a new resource-allocation descriptor, NOT a repaired old signed-key gate, quote-truth guarantee or forecast benefit.
decision.if_unstable: Keep only label-free row-state-token mechanism for subsequent model consideration; do not sweep sample sizes/purity/fallback choices.
decision.if_stable: Still require matched h_t-vs-z_t and/or clock intervention training controls, serving-ensemble contribution, chain-safe decoder provenance and native runtime; this round does not run them.
